title: NEXT F Standard Marketing Tracking Event Keys
description: Phase 9 provider-neutral website interaction keys. These are tracking observations, not the full platform-domain Event Registry introduced in Phase 13.

events.label: Page Viewed
events.description: A visitor-visible page or route view was observed.

events.label: Phone Clicked
events.description: A telephone action link was activated.

events.label: Email Clicked
events.description: An email action link was activated.

events.label: WhatsApp Clicked
events.description: A WhatsApp action link was activated.

events.label: Document Downloaded
events.description: A tracked public document download was initiated.

events.label: Form Started
events.description: Meaningful interaction with a registered form began.

events.label: Form Submitted
events.description: A registered form submission was accepted by the website/application flow.

events.label: Lead Created
events.description: A canonical Lead was created from an accepted source.

events.label: Search Performed
events.description: A visitor executed an on-site search.

events.label: Video Started
events.description: A tracked video began playback after user or permitted automatic action.

events.label: Video Completed
events.description: A tracked video reached its configured completion threshold.

events.label: Newsletter Subscribed
events.description: A newsletter subscription workflow completed successfully.
